TRip includes a curated GLB subset for the portable field laboratory: flasks,
retort, separatory funnel, ring stand, thermometer, stirring rod, scale,
magnifying glass, wash bottle, test-tube rack, forceps and evaporating dish.
The original `License.txt` is retained next to the models.
